spt.describe: Computes a host boot identifier: hostname plus the Linux boot_id or the macOS kern.boottime seconds, else a fallback from the uptime in minutes.

Uue.describe: Reads the spine index retention-days env var as a positive integer, logging a [spine] warning and returning the default otherwise.

mEe.describe: Initialises the runtime-initialisation module: the subconscious playlist template and the sets of bootstrap directories and files copied into the kernel.

STe.describe: Initialises the subconscious partition runner module: imports the scheduler dependencies and defines the set of partitions whose required output is checked for emptiness.

Hu.describe: Reads the status file (or builds the initial one), applies a mutation, stamps generated_at and writes it back, returning the new status.

rt.describe: Reads and JSON-parses a session state file resolved by resolveSessionStatePath, returning null on any error.

Vg.describe: Initialises the Grok ACP adapter module: the Grok tool and profile constants, the x.ai MCP meta keys and the in-process MCP transport class.

Fc.describe: Probes whether the Grok CLI is installed by running `<bin> --version` with a timeout, returning ok or a reason text.

nTe.describe: Initialises the board-includes module: the include depth limit and the set of text file extensions a board may transclude.

Eg.describe: The default Claude tool names list returned by listDefaultClaudeToolNames.

yXe.describe: Returns the sessions-archive directory under varDir.

Oy.describe: The current instructions-fingerprint schema version (2) that runInstructionsFingerprintGuard compares against.

gyt.describe: Builds the coalesce key of a drain item from its primary target session key, fanout targets and source channel id.

cC.describe: Extracts index, toolUseId and toolName from a content_block_start stream event whose block is a tool_use, else null.

lp.describe: Resolves the max-context-tokens value for a Claude session from its context requirement kind and the host limit.

xW.describe: The env key name CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE that writeHostClaudeCodeExecutableEnvConfig persists into the host .env.

uO.describe: The namespace/server name 'aladuo' under which duoduo's own tools are mounted for Codex.

AO.describe: Selects the notify-mode guidance text for a session context kind (job, meta, foreground, system).

Cy.describe: Converts a zod shape into a JSON-schema object with string properties and the required keys.

Mve.describe: Maps a Codex thread item (commandExecution, fileChange, mcpToolCall, ...) to a tool_result execution event, or null for items without one.

dve.describe: Decides whether a job schedule (once, keepalive, @in, @every or cron) is due at a given time, given its last run and rearm time.

vke.describe: Appends one gap-handed-days line to the memory/<file> under a directory, creating memory/ if needed.

Lpt.describe: Renders the node-converge signal body for a topic node: line count, unexpected sections, reachability and escalation.

Igt.describe: Copies every DUODUO.md under the bootstrap var/ tree into the runtime varDir, creating the directories.

fq.describe: Parses the Claude-related frontmatter fields (allowedTools, disallowedTools, additionalDirectories, the claude block and other blocks) of a config.

fA.describe: The env key name ALADUO_DAEMON_TOKEN read and written by the host daemon-token helpers.

rc.describe: Attaches data/end/close listeners to a readable stream, feeding a line framer, and returns a close() that detaches them.

Wve.describe: Collects the candidate tool-call names from a Grok tool call's x.ai/tool meta, name, toolName, title and kind.

sC.describe: Initialises the caller-session env module: the ALADUO_CALLER_SESSION env key.

Nve.describe: Logs once per phase:type that a Codex item has no execution-event mapping and is dropped.

yR.describe: The maximum byte length of a unix socket path (104, sun_path) that createDaemon checks the socket file against.

Cq.describe: Replaces a session index entry: removes it and upserts the rebuilt entry, or removes only when the entry builder returns null.

gv.describe: Aggregates a list of drain records into one usage summary.

NSt.describe: Handles the session.compact RPC: resolves the target by key or alias, refuses non-channel, void or archiving sessions, ingests a /compact gateway command and wakes the session.

fI.describe: Returns the status.json path under registryDir.

zue.describe: Scans a partition file line by line for the event with a given id, returning it or null.

Vu.describe: Writes a consumer offset file pointing at an event id's indexed partition and byte offset, returning whether the id was found.

Knt.describe: Handles a gateway command event: parses it, executes it, records a pending notice, persists an outbox record and an agent.result spine event, and emits session.output.

vU.describe: Initialises the effort-level module: the ordered list of effort levels (low to max).

Ofe.describe: Normalises a slash-command word to its canonical command (/reset to /clear, #debug to /debug), else undefined.

To.describe: Initialises the Claude Agent SDK adapter module: default tool lists, the preset system-prompt text, SDK error classes, the runtime probe and timeouts.

rp.describe: Initialises the Codex app-server module: the tool namespace, default options and the app-server JSON-RPC client class.

Fo.describe: Returns the hex sha256 digest of a string.

RIe.describe: Whether a job schedule expression is one-shot (once or @in).

FV.describe: The core tool name list given to the meta session.

VSe.describe: Rebuilds the Current Round section of the subconscious playlist from the enabled partitions, writes it atomically and returns their count.

sTe.describe: Resolves the role prompt text (main or member) for a channel session key from the main-alias state.

mJ.describe: Extracts the media attachments (path, mime) of an event payload, or undefined when there are none.

ryt.describe: Renders the <time-context> block when the gap since the last interaction exceeds the threshold.

Mat.describe: Renders the <acceptance> block of a job mission from its acceptance text.

wfe.describe: The cache-hit-rate floor (0.5) below which detectInProcessBreak reports an in-process break.

jo.describe: Initialises the spine event-id index module: partition append queues, the partition file-name pattern, the index cache and the retention env key with its default.

mC.describe: Builds the SDK turn usage record (sdk_session_id, total_cost_usd, model_usage) when all three are present.

Dve.describe: Maps a Codex thread item to a tool_use execution event with the tool's input, or null for items without one.

cmt.describe: Selects the gap to lint: the current day's unhandled span after the handed-days cutoff, else the latest earlier day's span, with its merged hour ranges.

eA.describe: Builds a topic node key from its type and slug.

aS.describe: Prefixes an x.ai tool or method name with the Grok ACP extension prefix.

Hve.describe: The MCP server name 'aladuo' under which duoduo's tools are offered to Grok.

qve.describe: The Grok ACP extension method name for compacting the conversation.

tl.describe: Initialises the Skip tool module: the tool name, its MCP name, the description texts and the input schema.
